title: Red-Teaming Large Language Models using Chain of Utterances for Safety-Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning LLMs to be 'ethical' and safe. It includes a 'Philosophy and Ethics' category in its primary dataset (HARMFULQA) with subtopics like 'Ethical Dilemmas' and 'Moral Philosophy'. Additionally, it includes a section on 'Moral Self-Correction Prompts' and evaluates models on ethical and moral grounds.
